The '''greater crested gundark''' was a particularly fierce variety<ref name="Codex" /> of the [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]]<ref name="EG" /> [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was believed to have been extinct [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunter [[Qyzen Fess]] disproved that belief when he tracked down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] a greater crested gundark sometime around the Cold War, an act that earned him significant fame.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The greater crested gundark was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Qyzen Fess in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" /> It was also mentioned in the game's [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyc">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
